notes.title: Andromeda Six is Available Now!
notes.notes: [p]Andromeda Six is now available on Steam!! Thank you so much for all your patience, and we hope that those of you who have been waiting enjoy the game! Please be advised that A6 is still in early access, and the version available on Steam contains Episodes 1-9 and will receive future updates alongside our Itch and Patreon shop versions.[/p]

notes.title: Andromeda Six Newsletter | September 2025
notes.notes: [p][b]Hi Travelers![/b][/p][p align="start"]Welcome to another newsletter! This one is going to be pretty short, as most of our past month has been spent working up to the Steam release. We apologise again for the delay with this, and assure you that we are just as frustrated by these events as we're sure you understandably are.[/p][p align="start"]While we initially believed that we had submitted the game build with plenty of time to be approved by our planned release date, we've had a lot of back and forth with the Steam team trying to get the build approved, and a lot of the issues have stemmed from any NSFW content in game needing to be thoroughly verified and accurately reflected in the content warnings.[/p][p align="start"]There have been a couple of you worrying that we may have to remove content from the game, but at this stage we can say that the build will be the same as it currently is on Itch, and our Patreon shop.[/p][p align="start"]While we're waiting on this to be resolved, we're still working on the Episode 10 beta for Patreon, and have had a small update added this month. After the Steam release we're hoping to pick up the pace on the beta, and will be focusing on that all the way through to the Episode 10 release.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40732430/bcd11f5066c093d6820b645e67d34cb623591898.png"][/img][i](A preview of Calderon's scene in the new Episode 10 beta version!)[/i][/p][p align="start"]We also have a new UI incoming, which will be added to one of the upcoming beta updates, and publicly launched with the Episode 10 release, and we're very excited to bring a new look to A6![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40732430/644d8ae0f7f7596e32d15734cbc6093c50935475.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Thank you again to all of you for your patience and understanding while we navigate our Steam release. As soon as we get the green light from the platform we will be back to finally announce our release, and we look forward to celebrating with you all soon! 🚀[/p][p align="start"][b][url="https://x.com/wanderlustgame_"]X[/url] | [url="https://bsky.app/profile/wanderlustgames.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url] | [url="https://discord.gg/3kkPpwe8N9"]Discord[/url] | [url="https://itch.io/"]itch.io[/url] | [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1642870/Andromeda_Six/"]Steam[/url][/b][/p]

notes.title: Steam Release Delay
notes.notes: [p]Hi Travelers,[/p][p]You may have seen on our social media pages that our release of Andromeda Six Early Access here on Steam has been delayed while we address some issues we're facing with our build. Today we're here to just give you another quick update that we're waiting on the go ahead from the Steam team, and will be releasing as soon as we can.[/p][p]To avoid further disappointment we won't be giving a timeframe on when we expect the release to happen, but we are hopeful that the wait won't be long now, and we'll post another update once the release is ready to go. We appreciate your patience and understanding during this time![/p][p][/p][p]The Wanderlust Games Team[/p]

notes.title: Early Access Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
With five Episodes released, and a sixth on its way, we'll soon be releasing the available content for Andromeda Six on Steam as Early Access!

Once Early Access is live, the game will be updated on Steam at the same time as other platforms, and by adding the game to your library you'll be able to keep up with any updates or news coming in the future.

Thank you for your support, and we'll see you again soon!
